dev.name: Local Dev Instance (Residential IP)
dev.description: Bypasses YouTube Cloud IP blocks for transcript fetching.

flows.title: Automated Video Ingestion
flows.description: New video triggers webhook to save in pending queue.

steps.details: Creator publishes a new video, triggering an Atom XML feed push.
Worker receives the webhook, verifies the feed, and extracts video ID.
Worker triggers the Trigger.dev task via API.
Task resolves the category and adds the video to the Cloudflare KV pending list.

flows.title: Approval & Queue Management
flows.description: Admin manages pending videos via the Chrome Extension.

steps.details: Admin opens the popup and reviews the queue fetched from KV.
Admin clicks Process. Extension sends local API request to docker container.
Server natively triggers the Trigger.dev processing task.

flows.title: Video Analysis Core (Local-First)
flows.description: Transcript extraction via Local IP, LLM synthesis, and delivery.

steps.details: Local Dev instance fetches the transcript using residential IP to avoid Cloud blocking.
Transcript sent to Gemini with category-specific prompts and selected model (Lite/Flash/Pro).
Structured Markdown result and token usage costs are saved to KV.
Final Markdown document is pushed via Telegram API.
Admin receives the rendered Markdown document in Telegram.

flows.title: Category & Prompt Config
flows.description: Manage analysis behavior and model selection.

steps.details: User configures custom prompts and assigns specific Gemini models to categories in the Categories tab.
Configuration updates are sent to the local bridge.
Prompts and model preferences are persisted to Cloudflare KV.

flows.title: Daily Email Digest
flows.description: Aggregates the day's analyses into an HTML email.

steps.details: Task fetches all analyses generated during the current day.
HTML digest is compiled and delivered via SMTP provider.
Email arrives in the user inbox.
